description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of four different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linear and spans integer values from 1 to 10, with tick marks at each integer. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Four lines represent different DPR configurations: a solid black line for “DPR w/o query,” which remains flat at approximately 34.3 across all S values; a solid red line with circular markers for “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” which starts at ~35.2 at S=1, rises to ~35.7 by S=3, and plateaus near 35.8 from S=5 to S=10; a solid green line with triangular markers for “DPR w/ document expansion,” which begins at ~34.8, dips slightly to ~34.7 at S=3, peaks at ~34.9 at S=5, then gently declines to ~34.8 at S=10; and a solid blue line with diamond markers for “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion,” which starts at ~34.7, peaks at ~35.0 at S=2, dips to ~34.5 at S=6, and declines to ~34.3 at S=10. A horizontal black line at y=34.3 appears to indicate a baseline or reference value.
